```{r start}
library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

# 1. Load the target variable data
train_power <- read.csv("train.csv", sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Load and rename the 7 forecast matrices
wf_files <- paste0("windforecasts_wf", 1:7, ".csv")

wf_list <- lapply(seq_along(wf_files), function(i) {
  df <- read.csv(wf_files[i], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  # Rename columns so we know which farm the forecast belongs to
  df %>% rename(
    !!paste0("u_", i)  := u,
    !!paste0("v_", i)  := v,
    !!paste0("ws_", i) := ws,
    !!paste0("wd_", i) := wd
  )
})

# 3. Merge all 7 matrices horizontally by date and hors
X_master <- reduce(wf_list, function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = c("date", "hors")))

# 4. Create the true target time to align with the training labels
parse_gefcom_date <- function(d_string) { ymd_h(as.character(d_string)) }

X_master <- X_master %>%
  mutate(
    issue_time = parse_gefcom_date(date),
    target_time = issue_time + hours(hors)
  )

train_power <- train_power %>%
  mutate(target_time = parse_gefcom_date(date))

# Join X and Y on the exact target time and sort chronologically
dataset <- inner_join(X_master, train_power, by = "target_time") %>%
  arrange(target_time)

```

Adding lags and separating data to be used.

```{r}
# 1. Isolate the raw predictors (28 columns: 4 variables * 7 farms)
predictor_cols <- grep("^(u|v|ws|wd)_", names(dataset), value = TRUE)
X_raw <- dataset[, predictor_cols]

# 2. Generate Non-Linear Features (Polynomials for Wind Speed)
# Adds 14 new columns (ws^2 and ws^3 for all 7 farms)
ws_cols <- grep("^ws_", predictor_cols, value = TRUE)
for (ws in ws_cols) {
  X_raw[[paste0(ws, "_sq")]] <- X_raw[[ws]]^2
  X_raw[[paste0(ws, "_cb")]] <- X_raw[[ws]]^3
}

# X_raw now has 42 base features.
X_matrix <- as.matrix(X_raw)

# 3. Create the High-Dimensional Lagged Matrix
p_lags <- 24  # 24 hours of autoregressive lags

# The embed() function shifts the matrix. 
# Column block 1 = time t (lag 0)
# Column block 2 = time t-1 (lag 1) ... up to time t-24 (lag 24)
X_high_dim <- embed(X_matrix, p_lags + 1)

# Generate descriptive column names for the new 1050-column matrix
base_names <- colnames(X_matrix)
lag_suffixes <- rep(0:p_lags, each = length(base_names))
colnames(X_high_dim) <- paste0(rep(base_names, p_lags + 1), "_lag", lag_suffixes)

cat("Dimensions of High-Dimensional X:", dim(X_high_dim), "\n")
# Output: [1] N_Observations 1050

# 4. Align the Target Variable (wp1)
# Because embed() drops the first 'p_lags' rows to create the lags, 
# we must truncate the target vector to match.
y_target <- dataset$wp1[(p_lags + 1):nrow(dataset)]
```

Run Elastic Net since there is a tonne of collinearity due to added hourly lags.

```{r}
# 1. Time-Series Train/Test Split (80% Train, 20% Test)
# We do not use random sampling to preserve the temporal autocorrelation
train_size <- floor(0.8 * nrow(X_high_dim))
train_idx  <- 1:train_size
test_idx   <- (train_size + 1):nrow(X_high_dim)

# 2. Local Standardization
# We scale the training data, and apply the exact same scaling parameters to the test data
# to prevent look-ahead bias/data leakage.
X_train_scaled <- scale(X_high_dim[train_idx, ])
X_test_scaled  <- scale(X_high_dim[test_idx, ], 
                        center = attr(X_train_scaled, "scaled:center"), 
                        scale = attr(X_train_scaled, "scaled:scale"))

y_train <- y_target[train_idx]
y_test  <- y_target[test_idx]

# 3. Train Elastic Net via Cross-Validation on the Training Set
# alpha = 0.5 blends Ridge (handles collinear lags) and Lasso (drops irrelevant features)
set.seed(333)
cv_en <- cv.glmnet(X_train_scaled, y_train, alpha = 0.5)

# 4. Evaluate Out-of-Sample Performance
pred_en <- predict(cv_en, s = "lambda.min", newx = X_test_scaled)
mspe_en <- mean((pred_en - y_test)^2, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Elastic Net Test MSPE:", mspe_en, "\n")

# 5. Inspect Selected Features
# See which of the 1,050 features survived the penalty
en_coefs <- predict(cv_en, type = "coefficients", s = "lambda.min")
active_features <- en_coefs[en_coefs[, 1] != 0, ]
cat("Number of active features retained:", length(active_features) - 1, "\n")

```
